name: postpad
description: Keep an entry in your PostPad showing what Claude Code last finished, or that it's waiting for your approval. No notifications.

ingest_url.title: PostPad delivery address
ingest_url.description: The entry's delivery address, e.g. https://api.postpad.dev/v1/ingest/<entry id>. Copy it from the entry in the PostPad app.

token.title: PostPad entry token
token.description: The entry's token (shown once when the address is created).
